# Jared Furtado

> Jared Furtado is an engineering student at Goa College of Engineering in Goa, India, and is still early in learning web development. He has practised with React, Next.js and Node.js through personal learning projects, two client websites (Global Tourist Centre and Techjeeva) and eight hackathons in Goa. He is currently learning DevOps through the 100xDevs cohort. He is interested in entrepreneurship but has not started a venture yet.

Website: https://jaredfurtado.tech/
Email: jaredfurtadowork@gmail.com
Location: Goa, India

## Now
- Learning DevOps through the 100xDevs cohort (https://100xdevs.com/) and applying it to his own projects.
- Interested in entrepreneurship; has not started a venture yet and is learning the business side through client work, a sales internship and events.
- Takes part in hackathons across Goa (see the list below).

## Client work
- [Global Tourist Centre](https://globaltouristcentre.com/): Client project. He worked on moving a tourism company's website to Next.js and learned how to add German, French, Russian and Italian versions. Stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, i18n.
- [Techjeeva](https://findfund.vercel.app/): Client project for FIIRE Forum (Forum for Innovation, Incubation, Research and Entrepreneurship): a simple page listing Indian government funding schemes for startups, with filters for sector and eligibility. Stack: React, Tailwind CSS, Google Script API. Source: https://github.com/jjf2009/Techjeeva-

## Learning projects
- [IntentOS](https://github.com/jjf2009/IntentOS): An experiment with Tambo AI's generative UI; you describe what you want to do and it tries to put together a workflow. Stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Tambo AI.
- [Ride Buddy](https://github.com/jjf2009/RideBuddy_Forntend): Learning project: carpooling for Goa College of Engineering students, where you can offer or find a ride and see it on a map. Stack: React, Redux, Firebase, Leaflet.
- [OpenCV Projects](https://github.com/jjf2009/OpenCV_Projects): Small experiments to learn computer vision: object detection, hand tracking and face recognition. Stack: Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, YOLO.
- [Nike Landing Page](https://nike-landing-lac.vercel.app/): A copy of Nike's landing page made to practise responsive layouts. Stack: React, Tailwind CSS, Vite.

## Experience
- Freelance web developer, self-employed (Dec 2025 – present): worked on the two client websites above while learning.
- Sales Intern, Avyott, North Goa (Dec 2025 – Jan 2026): B2B outreach for a text AI agent product; generated two qualified leads.
- Event Coordinator, GEC Coders Club, Goa College of Engineering (Jul 2025 – present): runs technical workshops and coding competitions and mentors junior students.
